latin: Non potest esse peccatum in uoluntate, nisi sit defectus in ratione.

mentions.context: Lucifer.81 What we have here is Pico’s interpretation of Thomas, using angelus beatior and subiective, which do reflect an adequate understanding of Thomas but do not appear as such in Thomas’s own exposition. Thesis 19 takes us to the heart of the intellect-will debate, and also, as we shall shortly see, to the problem of evil.
